feature: Run sessions: every session of a workflow run is visible on the run page (reviewer, panel and lane-review nodes, node pages, a Sessions list, night-shift decisions); read-only

scenarios.description: On the seeded sessions run, the stage shows 'Reviewer · general', 'Reviewer · coverage', 'Reviewer · critique' and 'Panel' as separate cards in the column before the review gate, each with its state word (general blocked, coverage late blocked, critique approved), its open P0/P1 count and its cost; a 'Lane review · server · round 1' card follows verify_server and a 'Lane review · viewer · round 1' card follows verify_viewer; the review gate, repairs and approval keep their places; the Now banner and the focus never land on a reviewer, panel or lane review node; a seeded older run with no lane-review records and one reviewer shows only its reviewer node added

The 'Lane review · server · round 1' node page lists its reviewer (transport pi, model openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol, status, duration, cost), every finding with severity, file:line, title and detail, the reviewed snapshot's short sha, and 'Fix round started: repair 1' linking to the repair-1 node; the viewer lane's round says 'Recorded; no fix round: rounds used up'; the stage card of each says the same in short form

The 'Reviewer · general' node page shows its session block (model, transport claude, status, started, duration, cost, session id) with the copyable resume command 'cd ~/<worktree> && claude --resume <id>', its verdict and only its own findings for the latest round, and its earlier round's verdict; the critique node page shows the critique session and its findings; no absolute path is rendered (renderedText)

The run page's Sessions section lists every seeded session in start order grouped by role (design challenge attempts, workers, repairs, lane reviewers, reviewers, critique, panel providers, night-shift providers), each row with label, linked node, model, status, started, duration, cost and session id, and a total line with the sum of known costs and how many costs are not recorded; Claude rows offer the resume command and pi rows do not; no absolute path is rendered

The 'Panel' node page shows the multi-provider panel's providers with model, status, cost and findings; the approval node page shows the seeded night-shift decision: kind awaiting_approval, each provider's option, text, confidence and needs-the-operator, the agreement, Jev's pick with confidence and reason, and 'Held: <reason>' (or 'Executed' with the redacted command for the executed one on the challenge node); the run page shows '2 panel decisions: 1 executed, 1 held' linking to them

At 390 px wide the reviewer, panel and lane review cards stack in the stage's top-to-bottom flow, the Sessions list reads as one column per session with no horizontal page scroll, and every link and button in the Sessions list and session blocks is at least 44 px tall
